summary: Founder Fix Round-2 verification PASSED end-to-end against the live preview (https://lynk-preview-2.preview.emergentagent.com). All 4 defects verified fixed: (P0 #1) /api/internal/fixture/rebase auth 401/403/200 semantics correct, secret never echoed, 503 not-configured branch present in source, and the endpoint genuinely wipes state (pre-pollute apps=1/hidden=1 -> rebase -> apps=[] / hidden=0 / passing=9 / excluded=6 / excluded_by_reason={no_sponsorship_offered:4, requires_us_person:2}); (P0 #2) gate-engine parity byte-identical between /jobs/feed and /eligibility/coverage-preview on the 5 contract keys both at clean baseline (9/6/0) AND after shortlist+hide mutations (passing=7, excluded=7, hidden=1, duplicate_application=1 in both); (P0 #3) reason_codes carry weight_ideal on every one of the 9 factors, sum(weight_ideal)==100 -> counterfactual can be honest; (P1 #4) feedback round-trip works — GET returns null on fresh, POST helpful:true then GET returns {helpful:true, note, ts, id}, flip with a new Idempotency-Key to helpful:false and GET reflects latest ts. Regression: full pytest suite 79/79 green (72 prior + 7 new e2e); round-2 suite 6/6. User Zero remains pristine: preferences {version:0, payload:null}, eligibility {version:0, status:'unspecified'}, applications:[]. Frontend UI portions (S9 modal on /feed and /jobs/{id}) skipped per review-request testing_type='backend only(skip frontend)'.
critical_code_review_comments: internal_router.py auth ladder is clean and correct: 503 not-configured -> 401 missing header -> 403 mismatch. Token never included in response body or note text — verified by substring check (SERVICE_TOKEN not in r.text).
reason_codes contract now honest: every factor emits weight_ideal alongside weight_applied, and the 9 factors sum to exactly 100. This is the invariant the counterfactual UI copy relies on.

GET /api/v1/matches/for-job/{id} now correctly surfaces the LAST feedback (order-by ts desc) — verified by flipping helpful:true -> helpful:false with distinct Idempotency-Keys and observing the flip on GET.

conftest.py autouse module-scope rebase for the 3 allowlisted test modules is well-scoped: it does not affect unit tests that don't hit the live backend, and the swallow-on-non-200 pattern keeps offline unit runs green.
Rebase re-seeds consents so re-login succeeds without a fresh consent-grant call — matches the expectation documented in test_credentials.md.
